# Calibration ensembles

A single-seed test shows that one seed passes. Each row below re-runs such a check over 200 independent seeds, and counts how often its tolerance passes and how often its stated interval covers the known truth. The protocol, bars and predictions were pre-registered before the first run, in [`docs/design/evidence/cap10-calibration/PREREGISTRATION.md`](design/evidence/cap10-calibration/PREREGISTRATION.md). The per-seed values are in [`docs/data/calibration-ensembles.csv`](data/calibration-ensembles.csv).

The oracles are closed forms on the engine's own models: **MODELLED**. A calibration ensemble checks that a statistic is honest about its own spread, not that the model matches a measured clock.

| Bar | Check | Passing | Pre-registered region | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | E1 c1: the 95 % interval covers the true mean 0 | 192 of 200 (0.960) | [181, 197] | MET |
| B2 | E1 c2: chi-square statistic inside its 99 % interval | 196 of 200 (0.980) | [194, 200] | MET |
| B3 | E1 c3: interval half-width within 25 % of 1.96 sigma/sqrt(n) | 200 of 200 (1.000) | [190, 200] | MET |
| B3 | E1 c4: p05 and p95 within 0.3 sigma of the Gaussian quantiles | 183 of 200 (0.915) | [190, 200] | **NOT MET** |
| B3 | E2: ADEV(1 s) within 20 % (tests/calibration.rs csac_white_fm_adev_matches_datasheet) | 200 of 200 (1.000) | [190, 200] | MET |
| B3 | E3: ADEV(1, 10, 100 s) each within 25 % (tests/calibration.rs csac_white_fm_adev_curve) | 200 of 200 (1.000) | [190, 200] | MET |

E1 is `scenarios/campaign-monte-carlo-clock-holdover.toml`, 200 ensembles of 200 realisations each, against the closed form: mean 0, sigma = 16.459040 ns. Ensemble j uses base seed 1 000 000 + 1000 j and bootstrap seed 20260928 + j. The largest relative ADEV error was 0.0225 for E2 and 0.0919 for E3 (across 1, 10 and 100 s).
